provenance.method: Generate a dressed fit reference; then extract only visible shirt fabric with imagegen; uniformly register extracted alpha layer onto the untouched original base
provenance.alpha: Preserved generated alpha through deterministic uniform scaling and translation; no painted masks, chroma key, character reconstruction or nonuniform distortion
provenance.rejected_attempts: Earlier standalone full-tube shirt attempts retained separately, not selected for integration

qa.result: Sleeves wrap both original raised forelegs; no floating cuff holes, no face coverage, and hem remains above hind legs. Beads now sit on the neckline and no longer overlap the heart.
remaining_fit_notes: The new tee and accessories are crisper than the low-resolution original happy sprite; exact rendering texture parity is not claimed.
